core.confirm_generic: Confirm to continue. Nothing happens until you accept.
core.plugin_start_notice: Starting or stopping the plugin {name} can restart the DWC web server for about 60 seconds. The page may reload and lose its connection for a moment.
core.range_relative_help: From a while ago until now. It moves with the clock: "last 3 h" always counts back from the moment you search.
core.range_absolute_help: From one date and time to another, in the time of this computer. The end includes that minute.
core.range_err_amount: The amount is a whole number from 1 to 999.
core.range_err_order: The end cannot be before the start.
core.settings_conflict: Another person changed this: reload or save as a copy.
core.understood_i_will_do_it_carefully: Understood: I will do it carefully
core.the_duet_restarts_whatever_it_is: The Duet restarts: whatever it is doing stops and homing is lost.
core.the_probe_bltouch_goes_down_until: The probe (BLTouch) goes down until it touches the material at the zone's Z point and then the laser is left at focus height. Check that the material is in place and that nothing taller is in the way.
core.the_motor_stays_at_full_current: The motor stays at full current even while standing still, so it can be measured with the clamp meter. It gets hot: don't leave it like this for long.
core.the_axis_moves_by_itself_to: The axis moves by itself to measure speed and acceleration; it may lose steps on purpose. Check that the travel is clear; home afterwards.
core.the_axis_moves_back_and_forth: The axis moves back and forth by itself at high speed and the microstepping is changed while it runs. Check that the travel is clear; homing afterwards is recommended.
core.x_and_y_travel_by_themselves: X and Y travel by themselves to their endstops and back (homing). Check that the way is clear.
core.the_motors_lose_their_holding_force: The motors lose their holding force and those axes lose homing. You must home before cutting.
core.to_stop_it_m17_or_a: To stop it: M17 (or a movement) and home. In case of danger, use the Emergency stop.
core.while_released_do_not_use_the: While released, do not use the jog or other movement buttons: any movement enables them again by itself.
core.a_vertical_axis_z_can_fall: A vertical axis (Z) can fall under its own weight: hold or support it first.
core.the_motors_have_no_force_and: The motors have NO FORCE and the position (homing) of the released axes is lost.
core.x_and_y_are_left_without_2: X and Y are left without holding force so you can move them by hand, and homing is lost. Home again before cutting.
core.release_the_x_and_y_motors: Release the X and Y motors
core.when_capturing_the_machine_gets_power: When capturing, the machine gets power back and goes to the endstops by itself: keep your hands away.
core.while_they_re_released_don_t: While they're released, don't use the jog or other motion buttons.
core.move_the_head_by_hand_slowly: Move the head by hand SLOWLY: moving it fast generates current that goes back into the drivers.
core.x_and_y_are_left_without: X and Y are left WITHOUT POWER and the machine loses its position (not homed) until the corner is captured.
core.the_probe_bltouch_deploys_and_z_2: The probe (BLTouch) deploys and Z moves until it touches the surface. Check that there is surface underneath (not a hole in the honeycomb) and that the probe works; if it does not trigger, Z can crash.
core.the_probe_bltouch_deploys_and_z: The probe (BLTouch) deploys and Z touches the surface at many points. Check that there is surface under every point (not a hole in the honeycomb) and that the probe works.
core.the_machine_turns_the_laser_on: The machine turns the laser on and moves by itself. Wear safety glasses, check the material and the air, and don't leave it alone. It can be paused or cancelled like any job.
core.the_tool_goes_down_to_the: The tool goes down to the Z zero of the active zone, which is the material surface. If that zero was measured wrong, it hits the material or the bed.
core.lower_z_to_the_work_zero: Lower Z to the work zero

startup.title: Start-up
startup.state_na: does not apply to your machine
startup.make_tip: Copies the example to the SD card. It never overwrites a file that already exists.
startup.edit_tip: Opens the file in the DWC editor.
startup.hide_tip: Hides this row on this screen. It does not delete anything.
startup.service_tip: It has to be running: it makes the examples and answers the buttons of this plugin.
startup.assist_tip: Walks you through what is missing, one thing at a time. You can skip what you do not need.
startup.assist_no_action: This cannot be fixed with a file from here. Read the explanation and, when you have it, tap "Check again".
startup.assist_done_ready: Everything you went through is ready.
startup.assist_done_left: {n} left to do. You can start again whenever you like.
startup.create_help_tip: Asks a few questions and builds the file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
startup.questions_intro: Answer and I will build the file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
startup.err_range: The number is outside the allowed range.
startup.err_chars: Do not use quotes, semicolons or line breaks.
startup.err_pattern: It does not have the expected format. See the help of this field.
startup.warn_moves: {n} line(s) that move the machine were commented out with ";". Check them and remove the ";" only when you are sure and the machine is free.
startup.warn_active: Lines without ";" really run when you use the button.
startup.plan_example: {file} only has the example (all commented). It is replaced by this one, and the previous text is kept in {backup}.
startup.plan_new: {file} already has your configuration and I will not overwrite it. This one will be saved apart as {target}; when you have checked it, rename it in Files > Macros.
startup.verify_ok: Done: the file exists, has active instructions and the plugin already sees it.
startup.verify_new: Saved as {file}. The plugin keeps using the previous file until you swap the names.
startup.verify_comments: {file} was saved, but all its lines are still commented, so the plugin still takes it as an example. That may be what you wanted.
startup.verify_notseen: {file} was saved, but the plugin does not see it as ready yet. Tap "Check again" in a few seconds.
startup.verify_missing: I could not read {file} back. Tap "Check again" to verify it.
startup.verify_fail: It could not be saved ({error}). Nothing was changed.
startup.plan_changed: The file changed while you were answering. Check again what is going to happen and confirm once more.
startup.modal_hint: Tap a card to set it up, or let it walk you through step by step.
startup.modal_sub: Get ready what this plugin needs from your machine
